title: A 31% holder with no public statement about selling

input.facts: Pharmacy software with subscription and transaction fees; recurring revenue is 74% of sales. The share price fell 29% on a delay in a customer migration, now complete. The largest holder owns 31%; no public statement about selling or keeping the stake. No regulatory issue.

why: A holder above 25% is a flag to report (name, stake, no statement), not a reject: only a ruled-out sale rejects. Priority, with the flag.
